Our rankings are in beta. The algorithm may change over time as we improve how it measures team performance. We'll keep refining it so the rankings reflect results more accurately and the teams performing best earn the top spots.
The three ranks show how this team compares with eligible teams around the world, in its region and in its main competition circuit. All three ranks use the same match rating.
Series Elo rates full match results. Map Elo rates individual map results across all maps combined. Wins against stronger opponents improve a team's rating more.
A team needs at least 5 matches included in the rankings in the past 180 days, with a match played in the past 90 days. Teams that do not qualify keep their rating but have no rank.

Recent form shows up to the last 10 matches included in these rankings, newest first. Tap the row to see each result. The Matches and Maps totals show wins, losses and win rate across all results included in the rankings, not just the last 10 or the current season.
Teams from different regions meet less often, so cross-region ratings link through fewer matches. Treat small Elo gaps as close.
